posts.author: Nevanito
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I have been trying to find a plugin/script that allows items that have long names to be turned into scrollabe text (back and forth) instead of resizing the text font to fit the item window whenever the text is too long to fit in one sentence.
I've been looking for a script similar to this for a couple days and the only thing that really approaches what I have been looking for is a script made by Rominator2, but the script was made for Ruby (RGSS) and I haven't been able to find a similar plugin to this one for MV.
And I have explored all of my YEP plugins, and haven't been able to find something similar inside of them.
Does anyone know where I could find a plugin like this?
Thanks in advance.

posts.author: Nusseysen
posts.body:
Hi!
Have you tried checking out Moghunter’s plugins yet?
Some of them include animated or scrolling text effects, so there might be something close to what you’re looking for.
The idea sounds really interesting, though! I’ll take a closer look at it myself later this afternoon and see if there’s a neat way to make it work.

posts.author: Nevanito
posts.body:
Thanks for the reply!
I honestly didn't find a plugin similar to what I am needing, but I did in fact find a lot of other really useful plugins that I didn't even know existed and that will definitely help me achieve some of the things that I wanna do for this project. I will continue to keep looking for something similar, but if you do manage to find something like this, I would really appreciate it if you could point me towards it.

posts.author: Nusseysen
posts.body:
Tatarameehee!
Here it is – the finished version of my
Scrolling Text Plugin
for RPG Maker MV!
It makes item names (and other window texts) scroll smoothly instead of shrinking the font when the text is too long to fit.
Works across most item and shop windows, even with text codes and special characters.
Preview:
Even Colors now work great. <3
Download & Info:
[JAO_ScrollingText.js attached]
[README included for setup and parameters]
Built on top of my previous UI tests – polished it up and fixed the quirks in one long, productive day.
I tried to keep it ES5-safe so it works nicely in MV.
Let me know if it helps in your project – or if you find a window that still refuses to scroll.
Thanks again for the idea and feedback! That GOAT comment still makes me laugh.
Thinking about building GOATcontent — no more Eastereggs for me.
Tatarameehee – if it scrolls, glows or talks too much, it’s probably mine.
